question: The avoid-zone manager's geometry, so an AI plan can bend around an island: the zone record and its producer, the segment-versus-zone test 004179D0, the tangent walk 00422500, and what usn_2_java.scn authors.
answer: A zone is a 24h-byte record holding a hand-grown vector of 24h-byte corner records, a layer key at +0Ch and an AABB at +14h..+20h, all in the (x, z) plane. Layer groups (14h bytes, key at +10h) hang off the manager's twenty inline slots at +8h with the count at +58h. 00424D00 rebuilds the table at mission load by scanning the world for entities named AvoidZone or AvoidZoneG <layer> #nnn; every one of the 6476 in the shipped scenes is a (Path) entity and its PathPoints become the polygon, points closer than five units dropped, the winding normalised to a turn sum at or below zero. 004179D0 hands one running point to every zone in the group and so reports the crossing nearest its `toward` endpoint together with the zone and the edge (the edge's first corner) that owns it. 00422500 walks the corners both ways from the blocked edge, tracking the bearing to the far point minus the edge bearing across each corner's +1Ch turn, accepts the corner where that angle changes sign, and publishes it pushed `margin` units along the corner bisector, pulled back to the nearest zone boundary when the margin exceeds ten units. usn_2_java.scn authors no avoid zones at all.

corrections.was: 004179D0's body is not read here, so which zone wins when the segment crosses several is open
corrections.is: the zone that owns the crossing nearest the `from` endpoint wins, and the edge index is that crossing's edge
corrections.evidence: 004179D4..004179E6 seeds one running point from *from and 00417A0A passes that same pointer to every zone; 00416DD0 only ever moves it toward its `toward` argument, so the last write is the nearest crossing

corrections.was: 00417EF0's true-means-blocked polarity rests on 00417E90 having the same body shape and the same two callees; 004179D0 itself was not read
corrections.is: settled: 004179D0 returns BL, set only where a zone reported a crossing (00417A1D), and both wrappers copy their out values only when AL is non-zero
corrections.evidence: 004179D0-00417A39 read whole; 00417EDC and 00417F3C are the two TEST AL,AL / JZ guards

corrections.was: the corner records behind zone+0h were opaque
corrections.is: a corner is 24h bytes: position at +0h/+4h, edge direction at +8h, normal at +10h, edge length at +18h, and the signed turn the tangent walk consumes at +1Ch
corrections.evidence: 0041CD4D allocates 24h and clears the derived half; 0041A3F7 FSTP float ptr [EDX+1Ch] writes the turn as subtract(outgoing bearing, incoming bearing)

corrections.target: docs/SHIP_AI_PATH_SEARCH.md line 191, the hit edge index
corrections.is: confirmed from the producer: the index names the crossing edge's first corner, with -1 wrapped to the last corner
corrections.evidence: 00416E30 seeds -1, 00416EDC increments after the test, 00416F11 adds the corner count when the result is negative

uncertainty: The reading that 00422500's two indices both name the edge leaving the published corner is provisional: what is established is the arithmetic (forward index = edge_index + steps and the corner it published is that index; backward index = edge_index - steps while the corner it published is that index + 1). zone+10h has a producer (0041D099, from 00923810 and a vtable[5Ch](44h) query) and no identified reader. corner+20h is set to -1.0 and never written again; no reader was found. Which of the path interface and the entity owns the +54h field 0041D206 tests was not read, so the host method answers for the pair. The layer keys the scenes author get their meaning in 00424D00's unread tail, so nothing here says what layer 46 means.
